turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Rainy Sunday, a two year old and a very tired me. Film suggestions?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: For a two year old, short and gentle is the way. Look for animated shorts or a series of ten minute episodes rather than a full film.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: She does sit for the full thing sometimes.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then pick something with lots of music, bright colours and animals. Avoid anything with a scary villain, even the cute ones can upset little kids.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: had a witch and she hid behind the sofa.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Ha, yes, that happens. Soft stories about friendship or a lost toy finding its way home are safer.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And can I nap on the sofa while it's on?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: I won't tell. Just make sure she's in a safe spot next to you.
